items.quote: Peers observed that Liovi Fenason headed adoption of new technology tools for case officers, setting priorities for several teams.
Direct reports said that Liovi championed dashboards tracking service performance metrics and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Liovi managed the organisational restructuring of the department for her unit.
Direct reports said that Liovi supported senior colleagues on lean process reviews at the service centres.
She led long-term strategy for the sector across the department.
She managed bilateral negotiations on the water agreement for her unit.
